hints: Pipe Get-Process pwsh to Get-Member and save to members.txt, then pipe (Get-Date) to Get-Member and save to decode.txt.
Use pwsh -Command with Out-String > members.txt and Out-String > decode.txt.

Run:
pwsh -Command "Get-Process pwsh | Get-Member | Out-String > members.txt"
pwsh -Command "(Get-Date) | Get-Member | Out-String > decode.txt"
